description: This file defines the DashboardFragment class, which manages a UI screen displaying focusable device control cards for a smart home TV app. Each card toggles device states (Light, Fan, Air Conditioner) with visual focus effects and Toast notifications on click.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: A Fragment displaying focusable device control cards for a smart home TV app, with toggle functionality and focus visual effects.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up device control cards with focus, click, and toggle behavior upon view creation.

methods.name: updateCardUI
methods.description: Updates the visual state of a device control card based on its toggle state.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of DashboardFragment.
